body: That might be related to a bug that was fixed in 2.15.1. could you check? Also, do you have the requests/response? Thanks

I upgraded Prometheus to the latest version - 2.15.1, but I still have the problem.

Request:
`Request URL: https://prometheus.company.org/api/v1/label/__name__/values?_=1577954456741
Request Method: GET
Status Code: 422 Unprocessable Entity`

Response:
`{"status":"error","errorType":"execution","error":"block: 01DRVWKQ2RT4YA8QT23G09XMNZ: get postings offset entry: invalid size"}`
Have got the same issue here, is there anything I can provide you with to help solve the issue?

I also have the same issue.

**UPDATE:** I rolled back to v2.14.0 and I am able to get my graphs again

@gbolo Hmm... so 2.15 introduced this? And to clarify, this is only on the old web UI on `/graph`, right? Or are you getting the same problem on `/new/graph` (the new React UI)?

It's interesting because there weren't any changes directly to the old graph UI code since 2.14 got released on Nov 11, 2019: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/commits/master/web/ui/static/js/graph/index.js
@roidelapluie Ah thanks. I didn't see the TSDB-specific error. So not a UI problem then.
Was the block in question created by 2.15 or an earlier version? Can you share the HTTP request, and the index file?
@brian-brazil The HTTP request is in https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/6535#issuecomment-570146356, just the normal fetching of all metric names.
